Amanda P: Quick heads-up — vendor sync next Tue 10:00 PT with NV/AMD/Graphcore. Goal: lock press lanes + marketplace cutoff windows. Can we support a staggered press cadence (H100 -> MI300 -> Gaudi) or do we need a single embargo window?
Raj K: Staggered is more realistic given capacity constraints. Dedicated team saying H100 first is safest.
Sylvia (marketing): Single window ideal for narrative, but staggered ok if we get clear handoff messaging and exact dates. Press loves predictable embargo ranges.
Nick (vendor-NV): From NV side we can commit H100 press assets the week of 2026-05-11. Need final cutoff from you by Tue (the sync).
Amanda P: Good — so ask for concrete cutoff dates in vendor pre-reads. Also need marketplace code-freeze timeline from Eng/Platform.
ops-bot: Reminder: marketplace deploy freeze window must be set 72h before any public press date.
Raj K: Lab/QA can support H100 validation by 2026-05-04 if images are ready by 2026-04-28. MI300 and Gaudi follow 2–3 week gaps.
Sylvia (marketing): Proposed public schedule (tentative):
```
H100 GA: 2026-05-13 (embargo 05-13 to 05-27)
MI300 GA: 2026-06-03 (embargo 06-03 to 06-17)
Gaudi GA: 2026-06-24 (embargo 06-24 to 07-08)
```
Sylvia (marketing): If vendor dates shift, we can compress windows but will need joint comms signoff.
Nick (vendor-NV): Acknowledged. If H100 moves +/- 7 days we can adjust, but we need marketplace visibility by 2026-05-01 to coordinate partner press.
Raj K: Action: I'll confirm image tags and kernel compatibility by Friday 2026-04-25. If anything blocks we'll flag in the dry-run channel.
Amanda P: Action: I'll compile vendor cutoff asks and a single spreadsheet of embargo windows and press contacts. Will ping product press ops and legal for embargo wording.
Sylvia (marketing): Can someone create the press calendar doc (shared Drive) and add vendor POCs? I can draft the public messaging then. :thumbsup:
Amanda P: I'll create it now and share before EOD. Nick — please DM your press POC and the embargo contact.
Nick (vendor-NV): Sent DM with press POC and compliance contact.
ops-bot: Note: Add runbook step to auto-fallback to a smaller SKU if capacity hit during initial window. Ops oncall to ACK in next sync.
Raj K: Oncall noted. We'll prepare fallback images and a short rollback playbook.
Amanda P: Great. Meeting agenda for Tue will include: vendor cutoff deadlines, marketplace freeze dates, press calendar handoff, fallback playbook. Anything else?
Sylvia (marketing): Add co-marketing asset readiness (one-pagers + social).
Amanda P: Added. Thanks all.
